Be a patriot. Express your support for the Second Amendment.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Carbine Barrel, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Poison Ammunition, which is in addition to an Attack’s usual damage and other effects. When making an Autofire Attack with this weapon, the user may choose to attempt hitting up to 4 additional visible, valid targets whom are within 10m/yds of the initial target. Each additional target also requires expending 1 extra round of ammunition to attempt hitting. When done, the user makes a single Autofire Check at a -2 penalty to attempt hitting all chosen targets in this area and rolls damage once for all targets, like a Shotgun Shell.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Carbine Barrel, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
